title: Fasces
summary: FAS'CES, noun plural [Latin fascis.] In Roman antiquity, an ax tied with a bundle of rods, and borne before the Roman magistrates as a badge of their authority.

inlines.v: FAS'CES, noun plural [Latin fascis.] In Roman antiquity, an ax tied with a bundle of rods, and borne before the Roman magistrates as a badge of their authority.
